show.description: Sweet Revenge is a dramatic tale of love, betrayal, and justice. Rachit, a devoted husband and real author behind his wife Prerna’s success, sacrifices everything for her—only to be cheated, framed, and abandoned. As truth unfolds, Rachit rises to reclaim his identity, expose deceit, and find true love, while Prerna faces the consequences of her greed. Watch now.
